edged 0.44% higher to 637 as oil prices and bond yields eased, offering some relief to stocks. Oil pulled back from multi-month highs after a surprise rise in U.S. crude inventories, while yields stabilized ahead of key central bank decisions this week. The U.S. Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise rates later today, marking its first hike in nearly three years.
In the bond market, the U.S. bond was almost flat at 5.00%
UK's 10-year yield was up 3 basis points to 5.36%, retreating from 19-year highs as the oil rally paused and in-line UK inflation reduced expectations for further Bank of England rate hikes.
Germany's 10-year yield was up 1 basis point to 3.54%.
